title: 第五百六十五章 接下来要救治谁第五百六十四章 两个伤者在哪里
content_zh:
陆原指着的是倒在路边的那两个人。
那两个刚才在桑塔纳里的人，那两个王龙的手下，那两个刚刚被王龙让人打得瘫倒在地的手下。
这两人此时瘫坐在街道边，正瑟瑟发抖，就仿佛是被打断腿的流浪狗一样，蜷缩着，不敢站起来也不敢跑掉。
是的，他们就算是想跑，也不敢跑。
这里到处都是王龙的人，根本没有跑掉的可能。
而且他们一直跟着王龙混的，对王龙的害怕早已深入骨髓了，没有王龙的命令，他们当然也不敢动。
“小兄弟，你说是他们？”邱医生此时明显有点病急乱投医的样子，听到陆原的话，也就急忙要向王龙那两个手下走去。
“邱医生，且慢！”王龙一看，顿时就急了，急忙就拦住邱医生。
“小子，你这是在侮辱邱医生！以邱医生的身份，怎么会给那两个狗一样的家伙治疗！那两条狗只配让另一只狗给他们治疗！”王龙怒不可遏的看着陆原，“别以为我不知道你玩的是什么把戏！”
是啊，这个小子一看就是故意来陷害自己的，故意说伤者是那两个人，虽然自己让人把他们打了，但是那两个人毕竟也算是自己的手下，而假如邱医生真的听信了那小子的话，给这两个人治疗了，耽误了邱医生给真正的伤者治疗时间。
最后事情真相弄明白了，那不是要怪罪到自己的头上来吗。
而且这小子肯定知道邱医生在场，自己不会太放肆不敢对他怎么样，所以才敢这么陷害自己。
“就是，这小子脑子进水了吧，邱医生这种省城名医，怎么会给那种人治疗，有失邱医生的身份。”
“这小子就是一个啥都不懂的愣头青。”
“邱医生，你可别上当啊，这小子是在耍你呢。”
其他人，也纷纷说道。
心里都觉得陆原真的脑子有问题，这里面任何一个人都没有资格请邱医生来治疗，那么邱医生怎么可能是来给那两个王龙手下治疗呢？
众人都急忙上前，拦住邱医生。
“这事可不能就这么算了，这小子好大的胆子，竟然敢这么耍弄邱医生，一定要给他点教训尝尝。”
就在这时候，张莲香不知什么时候钻了出来，她说完，还讨好的看了王龙一眼。

显然，因为赵思思的事情，张莲香坐立不安，意识到自己得罪了王龙，所以此时连忙出来讨好。
“对，对，不能就这么算了，这小子耍邱医生，罪大恶极，罪加一等！必须严惩！”众人也纷纷说道。
他们不仅是为了讨好王龙，其实更是为了讨好邱医生。
“等一下！”
邱医生大喊一声。
众人顿时都立刻噤声不语，没有人敢多说一句话。
“我手机刚刚接收到了批示。”邱医生说着掏出手机。
众人都是心中一凛，邱医生对于他们来说就已经是高人一等了，没想到竟然还有人可以对邱医生进行批示指导。
邱医生看完手机，面色严肃，大步来到了路边那两个人身边。
众人此时尽管心里都充满了好奇，但是看到邱医生面色严肃，而且刚刚已经接收到了批示，所以这一次，没有人敢再阻拦邱医生，也没有人敢说什么了。
只是众人的目光，全部都集中在了邱医生身上。
邱医生蹲下来，很是细心的开始给那两个人包扎起来，很快，凭着他高超的医术，这两人明显好转了许多。
忙活了好一阵子，邱医生才站了起来。
此时，众人的目光，都更是惊讶至极。
“邱医生真的给他们治疗了。”
“不是吧，那两个人只不过是一般的普通小混混，竟然也享受到了王龙享受到的待遇，这也太不可思议了吧。”
“那么现在看来，邱医生治疗的人，其实也并不一定就是地位多高的人啊，刚才那小子说对了啊！”
“那小子怎么会知道的啊？”
“难道他有内幕消息？刚才邱医生不也是接到批示才知道自己要治疗谁的吗，而那小子竟然比邱医生还先知道，也就是说那小子可能认识给邱医生批示的人？”
“如此说来，那就不是普通人了啊！”

众人又开始议论纷纷。
王龙此时心里本来也就极为惊诧，此时听到众人再旁边议论陆原，知道自己此时不能不再说话了。
“大家不要太担心了，这小子刚才只不过是运气好，胡乱猜对了而已。”王龙又说道，“邱医生，你认识他吗？”
他说着话的时候，指着陆原。
邱医生看了陆原一眼，摇了摇头。
content_en:
Lu Yuan was pointing at the two people lying on the roadside.
Those two people who were in Santana just now, those two Wang Lung's men, those two men who had just been beaten to the ground by Wang Lung's men.
The two people were sitting paralyzed on the side of the street, shivering, like stray dogs with broken legs, curled up, not daring to stand up or run away.
Yes, even if they want to run, they don't dare to run.
There are Wang Lung's people everywhere here, and there is no possibility of running away.
Moreover, they have been following Wang Lung, and their fear of Wang Lung has already penetrated deep into their bones. Of course, they would not dare to move without Wang Lung's order.
"Little brother, do you think it's them?" Dr. Qiu was obviously a little sick and was rushing to seek medical treatment. After hearing Lu Yuan's words, he hurriedly walked towards Wang Long's two men.
"Doctor Qiu, wait a minute!" When Wang Long saw it, he immediately became anxious and hurriedly stopped Dr. Qiu.
"Boy, you are insulting Dr. Qiu! As Dr. Qiu, how could you treat those two guys who are like dogs! Those two dogs only deserve to be treated by another dog!" Wang Long looked at Lu Yuan angrily, "Don't think I don't know what kind of tricks you are playing!"
Yes, this kid came to frame him deliberately at first glance. He deliberately said that the injured were those two people. Although he had people beat them, those two people were still his subordinates after all. And if Dr. Qiu really believed the kid's words and treated these two people, it delayed Dr. Qiu's time to treat the real injured.
In the end, the truth of the matter was figured out. Wouldn't it be on yourself to blame it?
And this kid must know that Dr. Qiu is present, and he won't be too presumptuous to do anything to him, so he dares to frame himself like this.
"It's just that this kid is out of his mind. How can a famous doctor like Dr. Qiu in a provincial city treat someone like that? It's unworthy of Dr. Qiu's status."
"This kid is just a dumb kid who doesn't understand anything."
"Dr. Qiu, don't be fooled. This guy is playing tricks on you."
Others also said one after another.
He felt that there was something wrong with Lu Yuan's brain. No one here was qualified to ask Dr. Qiu to treat him. So how could Dr. Qiu come to treat those two Wang Lung men?
Everyone hurried forward and stopped Dr. Qiu.
"We can't just let this matter go. This kid is so brave. He dares to play tricks on Dr. Qiu like this. We must teach him a lesson."
At this moment, Zhang Lianxiang came out of nowhere. After she finished speaking, she even gave Wang Long a flattering look.
Obviously, because of Zhao Sisi's incident, Zhang Lianxiang was restless and realized that she had offended Wang Long, so she quickly came out to please him.
"Yes, yes, we can't just let it go. This kid is playing tricks on Dr. Qiu. He is committing a heinous crime. He must be punished severely!" Everyone also said.
They are not only trying to please Wang Lung, but actually trying to please Dr. Qiu.
"Wait a minute!"
Dr. Qiu shouted.
Everyone immediately fell silent, no one dared to say a word.
"I just received the instructions on my phone." Dr. Qiu said, taking out his phone.
Everyone was shocked. Dr. Qiu was already superior to them. They didn't expect that there was someone who could give instructions and guidance to Dr. Qiu.
Doctor Qiu looked at his phone with a serious look on his face and strode to the two people on the roadside.
Although everyone was full of curiosity at this time, they saw that Dr. Qiu looked serious and had just received the instructions, so this time, no one dared to stop Dr. Qiu or say anything.
But everyone's eyes were all focused on Dr. Qiu.
Dr. Qiu knelt down and began to bandage the two people very carefully. Soon, with his superb medical skills, the two people improved significantly.
After working for a while, Dr. Qiu stood upCome.
At this time, everyone's eyes were even more surprised.
"Dr. Qiu really treated them."
"No, those two people are just ordinary gangsters, but they actually enjoy the treatment that Wang Long enjoys. This is incredible."
"Now it seems that the people Dr. Qiu treats are not necessarily people with high status. That boy was right!"
"How did that kid know?"
"Does he have inside information? Didn't Dr. Qiu know who he was going to treat only after receiving instructions just now, and that kid actually knew it before Dr. Qiu, which means that kid may know the person who gave Dr. Qiu the instructions?"
"If that's the case, then you are no longer an ordinary person!"
Everyone started talking again.
Wang Long was already extremely surprised at this time. When he heard everyone talking about Lu Yuan, he knew that he could not stop talking at this time.
"Don't worry too much, everyone. This guy just got lucky and guessed right." Wang Long said again, "Doctor Qiu, do you know him?"
As he spoke, he pointed at Lu Yuan.
Dr. Qiu glanced at Lu Yuan and shook his head.
